title: Re-evaluation of celluloses E 460(i), E 460(ii), E 461, E 462, E 463, E 464, E 465, E 466, E 468 and E 469 as food additives
authors: EFSA Panel on Food Additives and Nutrient Sources added to Food (ANS), Younes M, Aggett P, Aguilar F, Crebelli R, Di Domenico A, et al.
funder: European Food Safety Authority; requestor: European Commission.
result: Modified celluloses, including sodium carboxymethylcellulose (E 466), are not absorbed intact, not fermented and are excreted intact in faeces. No need for a numerical ADI and no safety concern at reported uses; indicative total exposure of 660 to 900 mg/kg bw per day for all celluloses. The Panel noted that microbiota and inflammation endpoints reported in mice (Chassaing et al., 2015) are not systematically studied in guideline toxicity studies.
